intro: Music doesn't get passed down by rules. It gets passed down by choice — and by someone deciding that a song was worth carrying forward. A crate is just a collection of songs that mean something to you. There's no right answer here. The goal is to start listening like someone who cares about what they're hearing.

whyOptions.label: It makes me want to move
I don't know why yet, I just like it

shareTips: Play one song from your crate for someone else.
Tell them one thing about it: what you like, how it makes you feel, or what it reminds you of.
They don't have to agree. That's the point.
closing: This crate isn't meant to stay the same. Come back to it every year. Rebuild it as tastes change, voices deepen, and new questions show up.
There's no finish line here. Just an open crate passed from hand to hand, year after year.
Keep it open. Keep listening. Keep adding to it.
